metadata.metric_note: Distances are calculated from delivered GPS polylines; average point speed and duration are synchronized with the point table. Montréal's long island axis runs approximately southwest–northeast, so signed axis displacement summarizes the dominant travel direction.

insight_list.question: How do work-centered chains and discretionary-stop chains differ in leg and stop counts?
insight_list.insight: Work-centered chains usually contain a direct outbound commute and a return-home leg, while discretionary chains include more intermediate stops.

insight_list.question: How do destination dispersion and mode changes differ when shopping or dining stops are present?
insight_list.insight: Chains with shopping or dining stops show greater destination dispersion and more frequent mode changes than work-centered chains.

plot.title: Return-home Time by Chain Type
plot.description: The plot is generated from the supplied case tables.

insight_list.question: How are leisure or dining stops associated with return-home timing?
insight_list.insight: Later return-home times are associated with chains containing additional leisure or dining stops, whereas work-centered chains return earlier and more regularly.

insights: Work-centered chains usually contain a direct outbound commute and a return-home leg, while discretionary chains include more intermediate stops.
Chains with shopping or dining stops show greater destination dispersion and more frequent mode changes than work-centered chains.
Later return-home times are associated with chains containing additional leisure or dining stops, whereas work-centered chains return earlier and more regularly.
summary: Work-centered chains usually contain an outbound commute, a multi-hour work stay, and a return-home leg, while some include a short post-work errand. Chains with shopping, dining, or leisure contain more stops, cover a wider activity space, change modes more often, and return home later.
evidence_policy: Claims describe patterns in this controlled constructed dataset and do not establish causal relationships.
